items.a: FinOps for LLM brings the FinOps Foundation framework - visibility, attribution, optimization, and accountability - to LLM and GenAI spend. It includes per-feature and per-team chargeback, anomaly detection, budget governance, and continuous optimization of model routing, caching, and prompts.

FinOps LLM finds, cuts and keeps your LLM savings. It is a managed engagement built on three products we run for you: Tidal Audit (free, read-only), Tidal Gateway (a LiteLLM gateway we deploy and operate in your cloud for routing, fallbacks, caching, batching, per-team budgets and hard stops) and Tidal Telemetry (live cost by provider, model, feature, team and workflow). Savings are reconciled monthly against provider invoices.

One model. Free audit, then a flat 20% of verified monthly savings, measured against a baseline locked before anything changes. No licence fee, no seat count, no minimum. Tidal Gateway and Tidal Telemetry operations are included in the 20%.
Typical reduction in the first full billing cycle after implementation is 40–60%, depending on architecture and traffic mix. Real targets are set after a provider-invoice audit and workload review.

OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini & Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Groq, Together, Mistral, Cohere, Fireworks, Replicate, and most OSS endpoints. Multi-provider deployments typically have the largest savings surface.

items.q: Does FinOps LLM support chargeback & showback?
items.a: Yes. Token-level attribution to providers, models, features, teams, and customer cohorts. Monthly chargeback and showback exported to NetSuite, QuickBooks, CSV, or API. Custom dimensions supported.

items.q: How do you handle customer data?
items.a: Read-only by default. Billing and usage data is enough for most attribution work. Prompt and output data is only accessed with explicit approval, for specific optimizations that require it. NDA and DPA available on request.
Attribution and dashboards go live in under a week. Optimization implementation takes 3–5 weeks; savings appear on the first full provider invoice after go-live.

No. Every routing, caching, and compression change is A/B tested against production for seven days minimum before promotion. Regressions auto-rollback. Quality is monitored continuously alongside cost.
